title: a small amateur game i made while learning godot and ziva
author: Lazy-Western8139
selftext:
just wanted to share my first little game. i've only been messing around with godot w ziva for about 2 wks so this is very much a newbie/amateur project. im not planning to turn it into anything serious but mostly something for me to learn and have fun using.

tbh it was still trial and error and i used ai a lot while making it. still super new to all this so it's obviously not polished and still super basic but i'm happy with how it's coming together. it's a win for me and just figured i'd post the clip here in case anyone wanted to see where i'm at. any gentle feedback or pointers are welcome.

https://reddit.com/link/1tundyi/video/u2vomayynu4h1/player
